resident.title: Resident
resident.description: Follow decisions in your community, meet your neighbors, and take part in elections.
legislator.title: Legislator
legislator.description: Follow a bill from proposal through debate, a recorded vote, and enactment.
speaker.title: Speaker
speaker.description: Organize the agenda, recognize speakers, and keep the chamber moving through its business.
chair.title: Committee chair
chair.description: Bring evidence into the discussion, hear testimony, and prepare the committee’s report.
judge.title: Judge
judge.description: Read a case, follow the hearing, and see how evidence and constitutional constraints shape a decision.

election-board.description: Inspect legislative maps, follow candidates and ballots, and review the certification of an election.

worker.description: Find work, exchange goods and services, and take part in the organizations you help run.

operator.description: Explore the responsibilities of hosting a world: founding, identity, communications, and keeping the service available.
